answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The tundra holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the delta of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
